name: Casey's Very Bad Day
source:
It's a typical Saturday morning for Casey- until things start to go very, very wrong. Find a way to escape the mysterious house you've suddenly woken up in, and (probably) die trying. A lot.  

Inspired by Goosebumps books and choose-your-own-adventure games, Casey's Very Bad Day is a short light horror/adventure game in which you'll find yourself in a mysterious suburban home where nothing feels quite right. Will you escape alive?

[Edited from [url=https://heartpunchstudio.itch.io/caseys-very-bad-day]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
对于凯西来说，这是一个典型的周六早晨——直到事情开始变得非常非常错误。找到一种方法逃离你突然醒来的神秘房子，并且（可能）在尝试中死去。很多。

受《鸡皮疙瘩》书籍和自选冒险游戏的启发，《凯西的糟糕一天》是一款简短的轻度恐怖/冒险游戏，在游戏中，你会发现自己身处一个神秘的郊区住宅，那里一切都不太对劲。你会活着逃脱吗？

[编辑自[url=https://heartpunchstudio.itch.io/caseys-very-bad-day]itch.io[/url]]
